## Safety checklist

- [ ] I reviewed role and scope authorization.
- [ ] I considered retries, duplicate requests, and concurrent state transitions.
- [ ] I did not expose private evidence, credentials, API keys, or payment details.
- [ ] I added/updated lifecycle or audit logging where this is a privileged mutation.
- [ ] I tested mobile and keyboard interactions where UI changed.
- [ ] I ran Next typegen, TypeScript, and production build.
